info.name: SEC EDGAR Data Company Concept Search API
Search EDGAR filings by full text

params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search query. Supports phrase matching ("exact phrase"), boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), and field-specific searches (e.g., entity_name:"Apple Inc"). Leave empty to browse all filings.

params.name: dateRange
params.description: Date range filter. Use "custom" to specify startdt and enddt, or "30d", "1y", "5y" for relative ranges.

params.name: startdt
params.description: Start date for custom date range filter (YYYY-MM-DD format). Only used when dateRange is "custom".

params.name: enddt
params.description: End date for custom date range filter (YYYY-MM-DD format). Only used when dateRange is "custom".

params.name: forms
params.description: Comma-separated list of form types to filter results. Example: 10-K,10-Q,8-K

params.name: entity
params.description: Filter by entity name. Partial matches supported.

params.name: _source
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return in the response. Default returns all fields.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum is 10 per request for full-text results.

items.docs: Searches the full text of EDGAR filings using Elasticsearch-backed indexing. Supports keyword queries, boolean operators, phrase matching, and field-specific filters. Results include filing metadata and direct links to matching documents. Rate limited to 10 requests per second.
